tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Cambium XV2-2X Wi-Fi 6 Indoor Wireless Access Point is a high-performance enterprise-grade solution designed to deliver exceptional wireless coverage and capacity. Powered by the latest Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, this dual-band access point uses 2×2 MU-MIMO, OFDMA, and advanced RF optimization to ensure faster speeds, lower latency, and a stable connection for high-density environments.


With a maximum combined throughput of 1.77Gbps, integrated 5dBi/6dBi omni antennas, and a high-performance 2.5GbE uplink, the XV2-2X easily supports large numbers of users across offices, universities, hotels, retail chains, and smart IoT setups. It offers seamless centralized management through cnMaestro™ Cloud or On-Premise, giving network admins full visibility and control.

This access point also supports WPA3, 802.1X enterprise authentication, enhanced roaming, multiple SSIDs, and intelligent client steering. With PoE+ support, robust security, and long-term reliability, the Cambium XV2-2X is one of the best indoor Wi-Fi 6 solutions for businesses in Bangladesh.

Available now at OTECH BD with fast delivery and genuine product guarantee.

Key Features

  • Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) dual-band high-performance AP
  • 2×2 MU-MIMO with OFDMA for enhanced efficiency
  • Up to 1.77 Gbps aggregate data rate
  • 2.5GbE uplink port for high-speed backhaul
  • Supports up to 512+ concurrent clients
  • 16 SSIDs for flexible network segmentation
  • Integrated 5dBi (2.4GHz) / 6dBi (5GHz) omni-directional antennas
  • Advanced roaming: 802.11r, OKC, enhanced handoff
  • Enterprise security: WPA3, WPA2-Enterprise, 802.1X
  • Centralized cloud management via cnMaestro
  • PoE+ (802.3at) power support
  • Wall, ceiling, and T-bar mounting options
